Mewi — The Strays of the Harbour

Autonomous agents with emergent social behaviour — stray cats wandering docks, boats, and the edges of a coastal fishing village.

AI3DAgentIn Progress
GitHub ↗

About the Project

Mewi is a game about the kinds of connection that time shapes and eventually separates. You encounter stray cats in a fishing village — on the docks, near the boats, along the water’s edge. Each one has its own temperament — some cautious, some bold, some that make you work for it. You try to earn their trust, not through commands or mechanics, but through how you show up: your patience, your consistency, your presence. The bond, when it comes, feels real. And then life moves. You get busy. You stop coming around. When you return, the closeness is already gone — no goodbye, just the quiet gap time leaves behind. That’s the whole game. It’s not about cats.

Status

Still in progress, update this section as the project develops.

Research Questions

We are exploring new possible interaction of HCI. We are working on how to achieve our stray cat agent with knowledge of behavior tree/ robotics/ RL and LLM.
